newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus H1 net attrib rises - source.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus H1 net attrib rises - source.

text.p: A source close to Canal Plus said on Tuesday the broadcaster had made a first-half net attributable profit of 386 million francs ($75.4 million) versus 331 million last time round.
Canal Plus declined to comment ahead of the official release of the first-half results, due after the market closes at 1500 GMT.
Shares in French pay-television station Canal Plus firmed sharply on news it would post a higher first-half net attributable profit of 386 million francs from 331 million a year ago.
The stock rose 28 francs to a day-high of 1,219 francs before giving back some of the gains. The share had been trading 12 francs higher at 1,207 just before the news.
The group also expected full-year profit to be at least equal to last year's level, the source told Reuters. ($ = 5.122 French Francs)
